channel.title: Coast to Coast GME
channel.description: Two GME professionals, from the West Coast to the East Coast, talking about all things GME from the boots on the ground perspective. Coast to Coast GME is produced with AI tools, which help draft scripts, create artwork, and generate the voices you hear. The ideas and stories come from the hosts, who review every episode before release, and the views shared are their own.

item.title: The No That Built a Journal - Coast to Coast GME Premiere
item.description: Coast to Coast GME premiere: how a declined manuscript became FULGME, the open-access journal giving GME professionals a place to publish.
